anthropic_base_url.description: Base URLs for LLM providers (for OpenAI-compatible proxies like OpenRouter, vLLM, Together, Anyscale, self-hosted, etc.)

max_tool_output_chars.description: Maximum characters for tool output to prevent token explosion. Set to 10,000 chars (~2,500 tokens at 4 chars/token) to stay well under typical context limits while providing substantial tool output.

max_message_content_chars.description: Maximum characters for individual message content in tool results. Keeps each message preview concise while preserving key context.

max_concurrent_embeddings.description: Caps concurrent message-embedding fan-out on the API request path (the immediate-embed background task). The reconciler is unaffected.

max_pending_embed_tasks.description: Caps in-flight immediate-embed background tasks per API process. When saturated, message creation skips the fast path entirely and the reconciler embeds on its next cycle. 0 disables the fast path.

polling_backoff_enabled.description: Adaptive polling: when the queue is idle (or the loop is erroring) the sleep interval grows from POLLING_SLEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS toward POLLING_SLEEP_MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS by POLLING_BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER each cycle, then snaps back to the base interval as soon as work is found. Reduces steady-state query load against the (shared) DB/pooler.

polling_startup_jitter_seconds.description: Sleep a uniform-random delay in [0, POLLING_STARTUP_JITTER_SECONDS] before the first poll so instances that start together don't poll in lockstep. Set to 0.0 to disable.

polling_jitter_ratio.description: Multiply every poll sleep by a random factor in [1 - ratio, 1 + ratio] (0.5 -> [0.5x, 1.5x]) so poll loops don't re-converge over time. The backoff schedule is unchanged; only the returned sleep is scattered. Set to 0.0 to disable.

stale_work_unit_cleanup_interval_seconds.description: Minimum (jittered) spacing between stale-work-unit cleanup runs

deduplicate.description: Whether to deduplicate documents when creating them

working_representation_max_observations.description: Maximum number of observations to return in working representation This is applied to both explicit and deductive observations

representation_batch_work_unit_target_to.description: Minimum tokens a representation work unit must accumulate (summed over its own unprocessed messages) before it becomes claimable. Bypassed by FLUSH_ENABLED and by REPRESENTATION_BATCH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS age-flushing. 0 disables the accumulation gate entirely (equivalent to FLUSH_ENABLED for claiming): work units are claimable as soon as anything is pending.

representation_batch_target_input_tokens.description: Cumulative-token cap on the conversation window (queued messages plus interleaved context) fed to a single deriver LLM call when draining a claimed work unit. The first unprocessed message is always included, even if it alone exceeds the cap.

representation_batch_max_age_seconds.description: Sub-threshold work units become eligible once their oldest unprocessed item exceeds this age. 0 disables age-based flushing.

flush_enabled.description: When enabled, bypasses the batch token threshold and processes work immediately

max_query_length.description: Longest peer chat query accepted, in characters. Raise it for clients that quote recent conversation turns in the query. Workspace chat keeps its own fixed limit.

workspace_extra_tool_iterations.description: Extra tool rounds workspace chat gets on top of its level's limit. A workspace query fans out over peers where a pair query reads one representation, so it needs room to route and then recall. Not applied at "minimal", whose single round is the point of the level.

budget_enabled.description: Show a tool-call budget line after each round, at levels allowing three or more tool iterations.

brief_enabled.description: Add the memory-layout section to the system prompt and, for unrestricted pair queries, conclusion counts and the dreamer's `map` notes (when DREAM_NOTES_MODE=on) to the first message.

session_history_max_tokens.description: Session history injection: max tokens of recent messages to include when session_id is specified. Set to 0 to disable automatic session history injection.

max_tokens_short.description: Per-call output caps. The prompt asks for a fraction of these as a soft target (SUMMARY_TARGET_RATIO in src/utils/summarizer.py), leaving the rest as headroom so a summary can finish instead of truncating.

max_input_tokens.description: Input budget for one summary call: prompt, previous summary and messages. The message window is chosen by count, so long messages can outgrow the model's context window; the oldest messages in the window are dropped to fit. A fixed budget, like DIALECTIC_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS, kept well under the context windows of the configured model and its fallback.

telemetry.description: CloudEvents telemetry settings for analytics. These settings configure the CloudEvents emitter for pushing structured events to an analytics backend.

namespace.description: Namespace for instance identification (propagated from top-level NAMESPACE if not set)

high_volume_sample_rate.description: Sample rate for high-volume events: llm.call.completed, embedding.call.completed, agent.iteration, agent.tool.call.completed. Deterministic on run_id so traces remain coherent end-to-end. Aggregate envelopes (RepresentationCompleted, DialecticCompleted, DreamRun, etc.) are NEVER sampled — they're calibration ground truth. Design trade-off: at rate < 1.0, aggregate events still emit but their high-volume children get dropped. Downstream `JOIN ... ON run_id` queries will see parents without complete children — this is intentional (the aggregates carry totals; detail events are best-effort), but consumers MUST NOT rebuild per-call analytics from the sampled children alone or they'll undercount. If you tune this below 1.0, audit dashboards/queries that join high-volume events to aggregate envelopes first.

trace_payloads_enabled.description: --- Full-fidelity payload tracing (llm.call.traced / trace.content) --- Master toggle for replay-grade content capture. Default-off.

trace_max_bytes.description: Per-message cap (bytes) for captured content; oversized string content is clipped (with a marker) and the call is flagged was_truncated.

trace_purposes.description: Allowlist of CallPurpose values to capture; empty = all. Typed as str to keep the enum out of config (validated against CallPurpose at the producer, same pattern as LLMTelemetryContext.call_purpose).

cluster.description: URL points at a Redis Cluster (OSS cluster protocol, e.g. GCP Memorystore for Redis Cluster). A standalone client cannot follow the MOVED redirects such deployments return for keys hashed to another shard.

default_ttl_seconds.description: how long to keep items in cache

default_lock_ttl_seconds.description: how long to hold a lock on a resource when fetching DB after cache miss

pagination_offset_shim.description: Serve offset-paginated list requests (`?page=N`) with a keyset seek from a cached position where possible; see src/utils/pagination.py.

pagination_position_ttl_seconds.description: long enough to span a pause in a client's walk, short enough that abandoned walks expire

pagination_count_ttl_seconds.description: How stale `total` may be on pages after the first.

lock_wait_check_interval_seconds.description: Polling interval while waiting for another worker's fetch lock. cashews defaults to 0, which busy-spins the event loop for the whole wait.

max_tool_iterations.description: Card-refresh dreams only; capped further by the specialist's own ceiling. Deduction and induction use the per-specialist limits below.

brief_enabled.description: Deduction and induction start with a description of how memory is organized and conclusion counts by level.

brief_max_new_conclusions.description: Cap on the since-last-dream work list in the brief. A larger backlog is worked through over consecutive dreams.

brief_max_new_conclusion_tokens.description: Token cap on the same list: conclusions created through the API can be long. At least one is always shown, so one huge conclusion can't stall it.

budget_enabled.description: Deduction and induction see a tool-call budget line, the last iterations are reserved for writes, and the final call at the limit can still write.

notes_mode.description: Working notes carried between dreams: "off", "shadow" (written but never loaded, so a sample can be judged) or "on".

notes_max_tokens.description: Split evenly between deduction's and induction's own entries.

write_window_iterations.description: Iterations reserved for writes at the end of a pass. Unset means 15% of the specialist's limit, rounded, with a minimum of one, and at most one less than the limit.

vector_store.description: Settings for vector store (pgvector, Turbopuffer, LanceDB, Qdrant, or ChromaDB).

namespace.description: Global namespace prefix for all vector namespaces Namespaces follow the pattern: {NAMESPACE}.{type}.{hash} where hash is a base64url-encoded SHA-256 of the workspace/peer names - Documents: {NAMESPACE}.doc.{hash(workspace, observer, observed)} - Messages: {NAMESPACE}.msg.{hash(workspace)}

chroma_client_mode.description: ChromaDB-specific settings CHROMA_CLIENT_MODE selects the deployment shape: - "http": self-hosted Chroma server at CHROMA_HOST:CHROMA_PORT - "cloud": Chroma Cloud (requires CHROMA_API_KEY) Embedded persistence is unsafe across Honcho's API/worker processes.

chroma_tenant.description: Tenant/database are optional for cloud mode (resolved from the API key when omitted); ignored in http mode.

cors_origins.description: Origins allowed by the FastAPI CORSMiddleware

reasoning_traces_file.description: Path to JSONL file for reasoning traces

namespace.description: Top-level namespace for all settings, can be overridden by nested-model settings

timeout.description: Client HTTP timeout in seconds. OpenAI receives seconds; Gemini converts to ms.

DialecticLevelSettings.description: Settings for a specific reasoning level in the dialectic.

tool_choice.description: None/auto lets model decide, "any"/"required" forces tool use

SurprisalSettings.description: Settings for tree-based surprisal sampling during dreams.

min_high_surprisal_for_replace.description: Hybrid mode: min high-surprisal observations to replace standard questions

provider_params.description: Operator escape hatch for provider-specific request fields. Three recognized keys: `extra_body` (merged into the request body), `extra_headers` (HTTP headers), `extra_query` (URL query params). OpenAI and Anthropic transports forward these as identically-named SDK kwargs. The Gemini transport merges `extra_body` into the GenerateContentConfig dict and folds `extra_headers` into `http_options.headers`; `extra_query` is unsupported. Shallow merge with operator-wins — if Honcho and the operator both set the same key inside `extra_body`, the operator's value replaces Honcho's. Operators are responsible for picking a coherent combination of this and other config (e.g. unset `thinking_budget_tokens` when supplying an `extra_body.thinking` for Anthropic-via-proxy).

FallbackModelSettings.description: Independent fallback model configuration. No inheritance from primary.

PromptCachePolicy.description: Per-call prompt-caching configuration. Lives in config.py (not src/llm/caching.py) so ModelConfig can reference it as a field without a circular import. src/llm/caching.py re-exports this class for existing import paths.
